visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins at night in an urban outdoor setting. A young man with long dark hair, wearing a grey hooded zip-up sweater over a horizontally striped blue and yellow shirt and green cargo pants, stands in front of a modern high-rise building with orange accents. He gestures excitedly towards the camera while talking. The background shows city streetlights and a sign for 'STAGE GROUP'. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the illuminated sign of 'APA HOTEL & RESORT (OSAKA UMEDA EKI TOWER)' mounted on a dark textured wall. The camera then cuts back to the man who is making a peace sign and opening his mouth in a playful, surprised expression. (3) The scene shifts to an indoor hotel corridor. The man holds up a black and yellow hotel key card near a door labeled '1819'. He inserts the card, the electronic lock glows green, and he pushes the dark wood door open to reveal a brightly lit, modern hotel room with white bedding. (4) Inside the room, the man moves the camera low to the ground to show the dark patterned carpet under the bed frame, demonstrating the height of the space. He then pans up to the headboard where a colorful origami paper crane sits on a small shelf. (5) The man explores the desk area, which holds a white electric kettle and various booklets. He picks up a pink book titled '强運' featuring a photograph of a woman in a red hat. He flips the book to show the back cover, which has a full-body photo of the same woman in a black dress. (6) He opens a drawer to reveal bottled water. He picks up a bottle, rotating it to show a circular label with the same woman's portrait. He then holds the bottle up to a mirror, filming his own reflection as he compares the bottle to the room's contents. (7) The final phase shows a display in what appears to be a breakfast or lobby area. A box for 'APA President Curry' is featured prominently, again displaying the portrait of the woman in the red hat. The lighting is warm and indoor-focused throughout the room tour.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in Mandarin with a high-energy, vlog-style delivery. Background sounds consist of muted urban traffic and faint wind, suggesting an outdoor city night. An upbeat, medium-tempo synth-based BGM with a clear electronic beat begins to play under the speech. (2) A mechanical 'beep' and a metallic latch click sound mark the transition to the hotel room. The vocal texture shifts as the room tone becomes more resonant and enclosed. The man's speech remains fast-paced and enthusiastic. (3) A soft 'thud' and the rustling of fabric are heard as the camera moves to show the space under the bed. The BGM remains constant, providing a rhythmic backdrop to the investigative narration. (4) Distinct paper rustling sounds occur as a book is picked up and flipped. A bright 'ding' sound effect (mimicking a bell) is strategically inserted when the photo of the hotel owner is first clearly shown on the book cover. (5) As more photos are discovered on the water bottle and curry box, additional pop-like sound effects and short comic-style musical stings emphasize the humorous 'verification' of the urban legends. The BGM maintains its upbeat loop until the end of the clip.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lighthearted travel vlog entry where the creator investigates well-known 'urban legends' about APA Hotels in Japan, specifically the ubiquitous presence of the female president's photo on various room amenities and the unusual height of the bed frames. It aims to entertain viewers by confirming these quirks in a humorous, fast-paced format.
